Daily Agenda
Parliament,

Management Work
1. The Honorable Minister for Youth, Labour and Employment, Ramji Yadav, will present the proposal: "Let the 'Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Bill, 2083' be sent to the relevant committee for clause-by-clause discussion."
Treaty-related Work
2. The Honorable Minister for Energy, Water Resources and Irrigation, Biraj Bhakta Shrestha, will present the proposal: "Regarding the Long-Term Treaty between Nepal and India..."
3. The Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam, will present the proposal: "Regarding the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea..."

Bishnu Prasad Pandey
